title: Where Are You? — VOA Lesson 5
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 1 Lesson 5. Original VOA conversation audio and dialogue. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Hello, everyone! Today my friend Marsha is at her friend's house. She says it is beautiful. I want to see this house! Here we are!
dialogue.translation_ar: مرحبًا بالجميع! اليوم مارشا في بيت صديقتها. تقول إنه جميل. أريد رؤية هذا البيت! ها نحن هنا!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Marsha, I am in the kitchen! It is a beautiful kitchen!
dialogue.translation_ar: مارشا، أنا في المطبخ! إنه مطبخ جميل!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: It is beautiful. We cook in the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: We relax in the living room.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: I relax in the living room. Marsha, let’s go upstairs!
dialogue.translation_ar: أسترخي في غرفة المعيشة. مارشا، لنصعد إلى الأعلى!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Marsha, I am in the bathroom! I wash in the bathroom.
dialogue.translation_ar: مارشا، أنا في الحمام! أغتسل في الحمام.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.text: I am in the bedroom. We sleep in the bedroom.
dialogue.translation_ar: أنا في غرفة النوم. ننام في غرفة النوم.
